featured_reviews.review_text:
The worst decision I made this year was visiting this salon. I chose it based on their social media page, as I wanted to get a hair treatment and hair color done. When I arrived at the salon at 2 PM, the staff was so slow that I didn’t leave until 12:30 AM.

The main owner has no manners at all when it comes to talking to women. He yells and fights in front of clients, especially with his wife, which is extremely unprofessional.

First, they colored my hair and then did the treatment, which caused the color to completely fade. After the treatment, they recolored my hair so poorly that it ruined the nanoplastia treatment completely. My hair didn’t improve at all—in fact, they became even more frizzy and rough.

When I returned to work, everyone asked what kind of treatment I had gotten, and they started laughing because there was no visible improvement. These people just keep changing their statements.

Initially, I wanted to get a Botox treatment, but they convinced me to go for nanoplastia, claiming it gives better results. Later, they said nanoplastia doesn’t have as much effect as Botox.

They even guaranteed that nothing would go wrong within a year and promised a refund if anything did. But my hair got ruined the very next day—completely frizzy and dry. I sent them all the photos and explained everything, but they just kept making lame excuses and spoke to me very rudely.

The owner’s wife even went so far as to say, ‘I’ll slap you.’ The entire experience was awful. They also posted a video of me on their Instagram story  and it was clearly edited. These people are not only unprofessional but also dishonest—and their service is even worse.
I want to take legally action against that type of person seriously 😡😡😡😡
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
She availed the treatment and the complete service was provided as per the process. During the session, everything was explained in detail by the company trainer, including the expected results, aftercare, and possible variations depending on hair type and condition. The trainer also assured the customer that if she faced any concerns in the future, she could always contact us for support and guidance.

Despite the work being fully completed, she is now unexpectedly demanding a full refund. We respect her feedback, but we would also like to clarify that the treatment was carried out in good faith and with professional care. As with all cosmetic and hair treatments, results may vary from person to person, and this was clearly explained beforehand.

Our policy is always to assist clients with aftercare and to address any concerns, but demanding a complete refund after the service has been delivered goes beyond what is reasonable or fair. We remain open to helping the customer with corrective steps or follow-up sessions to improve satisfaction, but we kindly request that expectations remain realistic and aligned with the treatment process.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely disappointing experience and borderline misleading pricing.

I called the salon beforehand and clearly asked for the price of a men’s haircut. I was told it would be Rs 400. Based on that, I went ahead and got my haircut done. Once everything was finished, I was suddenly told my total bill was Rs 630 because I had received a “stylish” haircut.

Naturally, I asked what exactly counts as a normal haircut. The barber’s answer was vague and unhelpful. He just kept repeating “sir, normal haircut,” without explaining anything. When I pushed further, he said my mullet haircut is considered stylish, while a “normal” haircut is just normal. That explanation makes no sense. My hairstyle is not unusual, and I’ve been to many salons before. This is the first time I’ve been charged extra after the service without being informed upfront.

It gets worse. During the haircut, I asked how much a beard trim would cost. The barber casually said Rs 450. I questioned this immediately because I had just been told the haircut itself was Rs 400. How does a beard cost more than the haircut? His response was that Lakme provides them with a rate card and they have to follow it. That didn’t inspire any confidence, so I opted out of the beard service.

What this really shows is a lack of transparency and poor communication. Prices seem to change based on labels like “stylish” rather than being clearly explained before the service begins. The staff didn’t seem confident in explaining their own pricing and appeared more focused on upselling everything possible instead of being upfront and finishing what they started properly.

My advice to anyone considering this place: ask very specific questions, get every price confirmed clearly, and don’t assume the quoted rate will actually be what you pay at the end. Otherwise, be prepared for surprises at the billing counter.

featured_reviews.name: Deepika Gilatar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have visited this salon twice, both times in the evening around 7:30–8:00 PM. As per Google, the salon’s closing time is mentioned as 9:00 PM, but my experience suggests otherwise.

During my first visit, I opted for a facial. Since I regularly get facials done, I am familiar with the standard procedure. However, the service was completed in just 30 minutes, which felt rushed and incomplete. The staff even skipped applying moisturizer at the end, seemingly because she was in a hurry to leave early.

Today, I visited again for a hair spa, and unfortunately, the experience was similar. The same staff member handled the service and appeared to be in a rush. The entire hair spa was completed in just 30 minutes—15 minutes for cream application and 15 minutes for massage. The massage was not relaxing at all; instead, it was quite painful, with excessive pulling of my hair.

Overall, both experiences felt rushed and lacked proper care and professionalism. If the salon cannot provide full services in the evening, they should either adjust their timings or ensure staff are not in a hurry to leave, as it directly affects the quality of service.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Deepika,
Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We truly value your honest experience and sincerely apologize that your visits did not meet your expectations.
We understand how important it is for services like facials and hair spa to feel complete, relaxing, and unhurried. What you described is certainly not the experience we aim to provide, and we regret that you felt rushed during both visits.
We have taken your feedback seriously and will be discussing this with our team to ensure better time management, proper service steps, and a more comfortable experience for every client, especially during evening hours.
Your suggestion regarding service timing is also noted, and we will review this to improve our overall service quality.
We would truly appreciate the opportunity to serve you again and provide you with a much better experience.
Warm regards,
Sensation Unisex beauty salon
